title: “Excavating AI” Re-excavated: Debunking a Fallacious Account of the JAFFE Dataset
reasoning: The paper's central purpose is to critique the unethical use and misrepresentation of the JAFFE dataset by other researchers. It directly addresses violations of terms of use and informed consent, accusing the other researchers of breaching the ethics they claim to espouse. The paper further delves into the ethics of surveillance technology and concludes with a 'Lessons Learned' section that provides explicit guidelines for ethical research and critique. This sustained focus on research ethics and responsible conduct is a core component of the paper, not a brief, ancillary section.
